To refresh the ElmPay recovery lease, follow this applicability rule:

- Only refresh the lease if it is within 30 days of expiration.
- Always initiate the refresh process 7 days before the lease expires.
- Do not attempt to refresh the lease after it has expired.
- Each lease refresh request must include the current lease ID and the appropriate authentication token.
- Maximize the refresh attempts to 3 times within a 24-hour period if the refresh fails.

To route writes to the FjordDB leader, adhere to the following applicability rule: 

"Only route writes to the FjordDB leader when it is in a synchronized state. Do not route writes to the leader if it is in a recovery mode or when unavailable." 

Action: Check the state of the FjordDB leader before routing any writes, ensuring it is synchronized.
